- Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31

Nestled within the heart of one of 30A’s cherished original communities, Tailwinds and Tides emerges as an exquisite, contemporary beachfront haven. Seagrove, a quintessential coastal gem, seamlessly marries the expansive shores of pristine, sugar-white sands with the timeless charm of Old Florida. Its most distinguishing feature lies in the unrivaled natural beauty that surrounds it, where beachfront cottages grace the undulating dunes adorned with swaying sea oats, while majestic pelicans gracefully glide overhead.

The first level of this exceptional home boasts a truly unique design. As you step through the beautiful double doors, you’ll find yourself in the custom-designed family game room, a space dedicated to entertainment and relaxation. Here, a billiards table invites friendly competition, while a well-equipped beverage fridge and bar with a prep counter and sink ensure refreshments are always at hand. A bar-style high-top table complements the spacious living area, featuring four large-screen TVs, pool views, and easy access to the outdoors through large glass sliders. Beyond the doors, a luxurious resort-style pool awaits, nestled amidst swaying palms. The covered porch offers a tranquil escape, complete with a hot tub and a generous outdoor kitchen. The kitchen boasts a custom hood over a large integrated gas grill, a sprawling marble counter for ample prep space, and a convenient sink. For entertainment enthusiasts, a large TV is perfectly positioned for movies or sports viewing. Additional highlights of the first level include storage with custom shelving, a luxurious full bath with a splendid walk-in shower, and a practical laundry room equipped with a double set of stacked washer and dryer sets, making daily chores a breeze. This level is designed for both relaxation and practicality, offering a seamless blend of luxury and convenience.

Ascend the stairs or enjoy the convenience of the private elevator to reach the second level, where elegance and comfort continue to define this exceptional home. The main living area welcomes you with plush furnishings and the warmth of a modern fireplace, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The chef’s kitchen is a masterpiece in itself, boasting a large island with additional seating, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, and a custom hood over a substantial gas range. Crisp white tiles accentuate the kitchen’s modern aesthetic, while a convenient pot-filler faucet adds a practical touch. The adjacent dining area is bathed in natural light streaming through double glass sliders that open to a covered deck, offering picturesque views of the pool area.

On this level, you’ll find a King Bedroom with a private bathroom featuring a shower, providing a tranquil retreat for relaxation. There is also an additional King Bedroom on this floor as well. Additionally, a Bunk Room awaits, equipped with two Queen over Queen bunks and its private bathroom with a shower, perfect for accommodating family or guests. A convenient half bath on this level ensures that everyone’s needs are met. The second level epitomizes the fusion of style and functionality, making it an ideal space for both leisure and entertainment.

The third level of this exquisite home offers a cozy family gathering space that seamlessly extends the theme of optimizing outdoor access. Furnished with plush seating, a dedicated desk and bookcase area, and a convenient wet bar, this space is designed for comfort and relaxation. Double glass sliders beckon you to the third-level covered deck, providing captivating views of the pool area below. For those seeking an elevated perspective, a spiral staircase leads to the exclusive rooftop porch adorned with a charming pergola, offering an enchanting retreat.

This level also boasts a sense of luxury and privacy, with the Master Bedroom as its centerpiece. The Master Bedroom features a private spa bathroom that is nothing short of indulgence, complete with a shower and a sumptuous soaking tub. Skylight windows flood the space with natural light, creating a serene and refreshing ambiance. Two additional King Bedrooms, each with private bathrooms featuring showers, complete this level, ensuring that every guest enjoys their private sanctuary. The third level is a testament to the art of relaxation and refined living, where indoor and outdoor spaces harmoniously blend to provide the ultimate in coastal living.

Tailwinds and Tides is a masterpiece of coastal living, offering an unparalleled blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. From its exquisite design and entertainment-focused first level to the elegant and spacious second and third levels, this home is a testament to the art of relaxation and refined living. With plush furnishings, modern amenities, and a seamless connection to outdoor spaces, every aspect of this property has been meticulously crafted to ensure a truly exceptional experience. As a final touch of convenience, this remarkable property features a 2-car garage and a spacious driveway for parking. Whether you’re returning from a day at the beach or hosting guests for a memorable gathering, the ease of parking adds a practical element to the luxurious lifestyle that Tailwinds and Tides offers. This home is not just a residence; it’s a coastal retreat where every detail has been thoughtfully considered to provide an unforgettable experience for those fortunate enough to call it home.

reviews.text: We celebrated Thanksgiving with friends (6 adults 6 kids) at Tailwinds and Tides. The layout worked well for the families we traveled with and had enough space for the kids to hang with us or in a separate room. The location was amazing. While we had access to the golf cart and bikes, it was an easy walk to Seaside, Watercolor and public beach access. We enjoyed the hot tub, cooking in the kitchen, and playing games. This vacation home comes with a starter kit for toiletries, trash bags, dish soap and laundry detergent, however we would recommend brining your own if you plan on staying more than a few days. The kitchen has a good amount of utensils/cooking supplies and they even provided a roasting pan for Thanksgiving. The pantry is empty so bring your own spices. Communication with ELP was great. They were responsive and dropped off some treats for the holiday!
